# dls-check

> Saudi DGA (Digital Government Authority) design-system readiness scanner.

dls-check is a zero-dependency CLI + MCP server (part of Otto, dev.ottospace.co) that scans a
codebase for Saudi DGA compliance — RTL-first, IBM Plex Sans Arabic, WCAG 2.1 AA — a legal
requirement for Saudi government digital services. It flags physical CSS/Tailwind + hard-coded
dir="ltr" (RTL), font stacks missing IBM Plex Sans Arabic (FONT), missing alt / html lang
(A11Y), and prints the manual checklist for tokens/components/contrast/keyboard/parity.

## Use it
- CLI: `npx github:moradothmanepro-OTTO/dls-check .`
- MCP: run `dls-check-mcp` (tools: dls_scan, dls_check_code)

Links: https://github.com/moradothmanepro-OTTO/dls-check · https://dev.ottospace.co
